items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 11 September 2026 10:51am
items.description:
##Today##

Dry with sunny spells. Turning cloudy and windy overnight ahead of rain & drizzle arriving.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 17°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-3


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

W'ly 10-15 at first, backing SW 5-10 through the afternoon, increasing 20-25 in the evening, with gusts 35-45 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle later. Hill fog later.


##Comments##

Strong winds later.


##Tomorrow##

A wet and windy start with rain & drizzle, getting heavy at times before largely clearing later in the morning, leaving the afternoon drier, but with occasional patchy drizzle at times.
